whenever i go to the store (which isn't often) i try to remember to get 1 lb of brown rice, which costs me $0.88 usd. roughly.

i also happen to have a million bags of dried fig bits all over the place, and a few spices. and coconut fat.

brown rice prep:

1 part rice to 2 parts water. start off the brown rice (covered) on medium for about 10 minutes, then lower it to low heat for 35-40 minutes.

"they" say if you add coconut fat 1/10th the amount of the rice before you add the rice, right when the water is boiling, and cool the whole thing for 24 hours, half the carbs will be unusable. why not.

so i do that, but i add 1 part dried fig bits and 2 parts water to it before i get cooking. wow, these numbers are great.

  • 2.5 cups water
  • 1/4 cup dried fig bits
  • 1 cup brown rice
  • some cinnamon or cocoa powder
  • some coconut fat, trying to be 1/10 cup

and cook it all together, cool it for 24 hours, and it's pretty good with almond milk.

at least it's great for lazy people who don't care.

such as myself.
